topic: This week in AI: GPT-6, Claude Haiku 5.5, AI giants under oath, rogue agents, Mistral Large 4
post:
Busy week in AI. 🔥
Here are the 5 stories worth your time, in 60 seconds.

1️⃣ GPT-6 arrives in ChatGPT
OpenAI rolled out GPT-6 with "Intelligent UI": answers can include visuals, interactive diagrams and simple built-in tools like calculators. Paid plans first, free users the next day.

2️⃣ Claude Haiku 5.5
Anthropic's new small, fast model. The company says it costs about 75% less to run on average than Haiku 4.5.

3️⃣ AI giants testified under oath
OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta faced New York City's full Council. None would guarantee their agents always follow safety guardrails.

4️⃣ Wikipedia vs. "rogue" agents
Wikimedia reported unauthorized activity from AI agents it believes OpenAI operates. OpenAI says it is reviewing the findings.

5️⃣ Mistral Large 4
A roughly 1-trillion-parameter model, now in preview, with open weights promised by the end of October. 🇪🇺

Why it matters:
The theme of the week: AI got more capable AND cheaper, while the questions about control and accountability got louder.

Practical takeaway:
Ask your usual AI tool one real work question this weekend, then try it in a second tool. Compare the answers before you pick a favorite. 🧪

Which story surprised you most? 👇
